commands.name: search-jobs
commands.summary: Search and filter remote job listings by keyword, tags, location, minimum salary, benefit and company, with sorting

commands.name: list-jobs-api
commands.summary: List the latest remote jobs as clean JSON from RemoteOK's public API, optionally filtered by one tag (includes salary, location, description and apply URL)

commands.name: get-job
commands.summary: Get the details of one remote job (position, company, location, tags, full description, apply link) by its slug

commands.name: list-related-jobs
commands.summary: List jobs related to a given job (same tag), excluding that job

commands.name: list-tags
commands.summary: List every job tag key with its display label (use the keys for the tags/tag params)

dropped.name: list-company-jobs
dropped.reason: The /company/{slug} page is a JS shell. It ships only tr.placeholder.job rows and loads real jobs through the action=get_jobs infinity-scroll call, so the static HTML never has job data. search-jobs already covers this with its company param.

dropped.name: list-country-jobs
dropped.reason: The /remote-jobs-in-{country} page is the same JS shell, with placeholder rows only and jobs loaded later by JS. search-jobs already covers this with its location param (country code).
